title: Improving photocatalytic efficiency through Cu substitution in TiO2/g-C3N4 heterojunction nanocomposites for wastewater remediation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00080G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Phyu Phyu Cho, Phyu Phyu Mon, Mohit Kumar, Saiyam Dobhal, Subrahmanyam Challapalli
Cu-TiO2/g-C3N4 heterojunction nanocomposites exhibit superior visible-light-driven photocatalytic degradation of BPA and dyes. Enhanced activity is attributed to type-II heterojunction formation and efficient charge separation.
